prerequisites: Apple silicon macOS host with a Metal device
Yosys 0.68+ with ABC and the bundled minisat
Release test binary already built, so the capture shows a run rather than a compile
reproduce.behavior: Executes the real release test suite during recording. This is a live run, not playback of a preserved log.
reproduce.workspacePathConstraint: The tape cds to an absolute path under /Volumes/Code/MuleinLabs and records to another; both must be adjusted if the workspace moves.

capturedAtBasis: MP4 filesystem modification time at capture completion

captureMethod.mode: live execution of the release test suite

shellHelper.name: prove
shellHelper.body: swift test -c release --filter TensorLUTYosysRoundTripTests/$1 2>&1 | grep -E 'Executed 1 test|^TENSORLUT' | fold -s -w 104
shellHelper.rationale: A thin wrapper so the typed command fits the terminal width without wrapping. Its definition is printed on screen with `type prove` so nothing is concealed.

toolchain.yosys: Yosys 0.68+post (git sha1 c12172fbae8af5e20f6fb52e3d4e92d56ed587b6, Release, AppleClang clang++ 21.0.0.21000101)

circuit.description: two-bit adder as four LUT cells on fixed topology

erasedBaseline.purpose: proves the fixture is genuinely broken, so a later pass is not vacuous

search.kind: evolutionary search over Float32 LUT INIT values on fixed topology

enumeratedCheck.reference: the target truth table, not the source netlist

formalCheck.reference: behavioural Verilog `+` golden model, independent of the LUT representation

negativeControl.perturbation: one discovered INIT entry in the melt region flipped

claimBoundaries: This is a live run recorded on 2026-09-05, not playback of an archived log.
The circuit is a four-LUT two-bit adder. Nothing here establishes behaviour at production scale.
The search moves LUT INIT values on fixed topology; it does not add, remove, or rewire cells.
The proof covers a combinational design. No flip-flops are in this loop.
The SAT proof is against a behavioural adder reference for this function; it is not a general equivalence claim about arbitrary searched circuits.
Discovered circuits map to the same LUT count as hand-designed ones under abc -lut 6, so no area or depth improvement is claimed.
Elapsed test times are local observations on one Apple M4 Max, not benchmark distributions.
Typed command echoes visibly wrap or overlap at some prompt boundaries; the projected result lines and the on-screen wrapper definition remain legible.
